body: Commit 7330f10 (+ CHANGELOG). Spec-only pass, no code: pins down League's real minion-wave model (roles, aggro-redirect, last-hit/deny split, XP-share, structure pressure) against REDGARDEN's two separate creep systems. Headline finding: jungle creeps (ArenaCreep) aren't League jungle camps at all -- they're node-ownership guardians dealing flat unmitigated (no apply_armor) damage; lane creeps are the closer minion analog but single-role with no aggro-redirect/deny/XP-share. Proposes a sequenced target design, no numeric retuning decided. Closes the S170-206/207/208/209 sprint plan committed to BACKLOG.md earlier this session.
title: NORTHSTAR §20, full creep overhaul -- LoL parity spec (S170-209)
